item.title: Building a message queue with only two UNIX signals
item.description:
📝 Cannot be trapped or ignored SIGCONT - resumes a process that was paused by SIGSTOP SIGCHLD - sent to a parent process when a child process terminates or stops SIGUSR1 and SIGUSR2 - user-defined signals that applications can use for custom purposes Sending messages using signals Okay, we know that signals are a primitive form of IPC. UNIX-like systems provide a syscall called kill that sends signals to processes. After all, we cannot send messages using signals.
🔗 Read more: https://leandronsp.com/articles/you-dont-need-kafka-building-a-message-queue-with-only-two-unix-signals

item.title: Why UUIDs won't protect your secrets
item.description:
